main_results.CFM_1_per_pattern_forgetting: CFM-1(p, t) := self_verify_accuracy(pattern p, after epoch t). Forgetting_p(t) > 0.1 → significant catastrophic forgetting.
main_results.CFM_2_cluster_drift: CFM-2(c, t) := ||W_c(t) - W_c(t_0)||_2. Threshold: 5% drift → forgetting risk.
main_results.CPM_1_cluster_pool_usage: Spawn count V1, V2 + sub_pool_overlap_matrix (K × K Jaccard). 0 = forced-disjoint OK, > 0 = fallback mode.
main_results.CPM_2_weight_overlap_matrix: K × K cosine similarity. Threshold: 0.3 = redundant cluster, merge recommended.

hypotheses_4.H1: Vigilance threshold too strict → vigilance miss high → re-learning perception
hypotheses_4.H2: Sub-pool exhaustion (CONFIRMED by Screenshot 1 console) → fallback weight overlap → accuracy degradation
hypotheses_4.H3: Catastrophic forgetting via R-STDP weight drift → patterns 1, 2, 3 accuracy degraded over time
hypotheses_4.H4: Sparse code overlap (forced-disjoint fallback) → similar inputs activate multiple clusters → recognition failure
